name: Laliela
source:
LALIELA is NENE's daughter and she has been raised with SUI as her sister since she was a child.

LALIELA knows that SUI is the royal princess and she was raised as her bodyguard cum maid-in-waiting.

She is truly an incredible fighter.
She does not wear her heart on her sleeve and takes a cool attitude to all encounters, but begins to change as she journeys with SUI.

[Taken from Hirameki International]
